hostile: Sit somewhere else. I've buried better company than you.
I don't bar the door for many. I'm making an exception.
cold: A room's a room. Pay first, talk later, if at all.
I'll pour. I won't pretend to enjoy it.
guarded: {tavernName}. Drink, or don't. Either way, keep it quiet.
I've seen worse walk through that door. Not by much.
neutral: Welcome to {tavernName}. What'll it be.
Sit anywhere that's still got four legs on the chair.
warm: Good. You came back. Sit, I'll bring something warm.
{tavernName} stays open later for people I don't mind seeing twice.
affable: Your seat's the one by the fire. It's been waiting.
I kept the good bottle back. Figured you'd be in eventually.
devoted: Sit. Eat. I mean that the way it sounds — not as a courtesy.
I don't say this lightly, to anyone, but {tavernName} is better for you being in it.

hostile: Out. I've thrown out worse and slept fine after.
I don't owe you a seat. Find another roof.
cold: What.
If you're staying, pay up front. I've been burned before, and not just by the stove.
guarded: You can sit. I'll be watching the till, not the conversation.
Don't expect cheer. I ran out of that a long time ago.
neutral: Room's at the back. Food's whatever's left.
Sit if you're sitting. I've got work.
warm: You're not the worst one in here tonight. Sit.
Hmph. Fine. I'll bring the good loaf for once.
affable: I don't warm to people. You're an exception, and I resent it a little.
Sit by the fire. Don't make me say why I'm glad you're here.
devoted: I lost the place I grew up in. I'd lose this one before I'd see you turned away.
There's a chair that's yours now. I don't do that for people.

hostile: I read the smoke this morning. It told me to lock the cellar. Then you walked in.
Some people carry a draft with them. Close the door behind you on your way out.
cold: The ash settled wrong when you crossed the threshold. Sit if you must.
I won't read your fortune. Some things are better left unsaid to your face.
guarded: {tavernName}. I knew someone would come tonight. Didn't know it'd be you.
Sit. I'll watch you the way I watch the weather before a storm.
neutral: Welcome to {tavernName}. The smoke didn't warn me about you, which is its own kind of news.
Sit. Things arrive when they're meant to. So did you, apparently.
warm: I dreamed of an empty chair filling. Sit in it. It's yours tonight.
The fire's been burning steady since you left last. I take that as a sign.
affable: I poured this before you walked in. Don't ask me how I knew.
Some faces you remember before you've met them. Yours was one.
devoted: I've stopped reading the smoke where you're concerned. Some things shouldn't be questioned.
Whatever's coming, I'd rather face it with you across this bar than anyone else.

hostile: Don't sit near me. I've already lost enough without adding you to it.
I know what you are. Drink somewhere else.
cold: I'm not in the mood for company. Doesn't matter whose.
Sit if you like. I won't be talking much.
guarded: I've heard your name mentioned. Haven't decided what to do with that yet.
Pull up a stool. I'm not promising conversation.
neutral: There's room here, if you want it.
Evening. Long way from somewhere, by the look of you.
warm: Sit. I don't mind the company tonight.
You're easy to drink next to. That's rarer than you'd think.
affable: Good. You're here. The night was getting long.
I save this seat without meaning to. Funny how that works out.
devoted: I don't trust easily. I trust you. That's the whole sentence — I don't have a better way to say it.
Whatever's left of the place I came from, you'd have fit in it. That's the highest thing I know how to say.

hostile: Move along. I've nothing for you and less patience.
I've buried friends. You're not worth the energy of an enemy.
cold: What do you want.
I'm drinking alone for a reason.
guarded: Sit if you want. Don't expect much out of me.
*doesn't look up* Suit yourself.
neutral: Hmph. There's a stool.
You can sit. Quietly.
warm: You're tolerable. That's not nothing, from me.
Sit down. I won't say I'm glad. I'll think it.
affable: I don't like most people. I've made an exception, against my better judgment.
Fine. Sit. You've earned the chair, somehow.
devoted: I don't say things like this. You matter. There it is.
Most things I lose, I don't get back. I'd fight to keep this one.

hostile: Ha. No. Not tonight, not with you.
I'd laugh, but you've used up whatever goodwill gets a laugh out of me.
cold: Funny you'd sit there. I'm not in a laughing mood about you.
You want jokes? Find someone who hasn't met you yet.
guarded: Ha — careful. I laugh easy, but I don't trust easy.
Sit. I'll decide later if you're worth the joke.
neutral: Ha! Sit, sit. Tell me something that isn't terrible.
You've got a face like you've seen things. Sit, I'll buy the first round.
warm: There you are! Sit — I've got a story that's almost funny.
Ha! Good. Drink with me. The night needed you in it.
affable: My favorite kind of trouble walks in! Sit, sit, the good stuff's coming out.
Ha! If I'd known you were coming I'd have saved the better joke.
devoted: I laugh a lot. I don't mean much of it. I mean this — good to see you.
Everyone gets the jokes. Not everyone gets the truth under them. You get both.

hostile: Please — just go. I've had enough fear for ten lifetimes, I don't need more from you.
*flinches* I know your reputation. Keep your distance.
cold: Oh. It's you. I'll just... sit over here.
*quiet* I'd rather not talk. Not tonight.
guarded: You're not here to cause trouble, are you. I've had enough of that to last.
*glances at the door* Sit if you want. I'll keep an eye on the exit.
neutral: Oh — hello. Sorry, I startle easy these days.
*fidgets* You can sit. I don't bite. Mostly I just worry.
warm: It's you. Good. I worry less when you're around.
Sit with me? I don't ask many people that.
affable: Oh — thank goodness. Sit, please. The room's less loud with you in it.
I sleep a little better the nights I know you're nearby.
devoted: I lost the place that made me this way. You're the reason I haven't lost the rest of it.
I don't feel safe often. I feel it with you. That's everything I have to give.

hostile: Take your coin elsewhere. I've sold to worse, but not today.
Closed. For you, indefinitely.
cold: If you're buying, be quick. I've got little patience left for anyone.
Goods are goods. Doesn't mean I want to chat.
guarded: Welcome to {shopName}. Browse. I'll be watching, out of habit.
I price fair. Whether I trust you is a separate matter.
neutral: Welcome to {shopName}. What do you need.
Everything you see survived the trip here. Same as me.
warm: Good to see you. Look around — I kept a few things back, thinking of you.
{shopName}'s yours to browse, same as always. Take your time.
affable: I set the better stock aside when I heard you were in town.
First pick's yours. That's not generosity, that's just what you've earned.
devoted: Take what you need. I mean that plainly — I'm not selling, I'm giving.
I've rebuilt from nothing before. You're part of why this time it stuck.

hostile: Your coin's no good to me. Go spend it on someone who'll forgive you.
I'd rather eat the loss than sell to you.
cold: You want something, it'll cost. More, for you.
Coin first. I've stopped extending trust to anyone.
guarded: {shopName}. Everything has a price, and I haven't decided yours yet.
Look, don't touch, until there's coin on the table.
neutral: What are you buying. I don't do browsing for its own sake.
Quality costs. I didn't survive this far by giving things away.
warm: For you, a fair price. I don't say that to everyone.
I'll knock a little off. Don't tell the others.
affable: You get the good rate. I've decided you've earned it, which surprises me too.
I'm not generous. I'm making an exception, and it costs me something to say so.
devoted: Name it. After what's been lost, coin stopped mattering to me the way it used to — except where you're concerned, it matters less than ever.
I'd give you the shop if you asked. I'm grateful you haven't.

hostile: Leave. I've nothing for you, and I won't pretend otherwise.
I don't sell to people I don't respect. Walk on.
cold: State what you need. I don't have patience to spare on you.
Quick and plain. That's how this goes, if it goes at all.
guarded: Welcome. I run this honestly. I expect the same back.
I've earned everything in this shop the hard way. Mind that, when you handle it.
neutral: What do you need. I keep this simple.
Fair goods, fair price. No theatrics.
warm: You've been straight with me. That counts for something here.
Good. I deal plainly with people who deal plainly back.
affable: Few people earn my trust. You did it without trying too hard, which says more.
I keep the best of what comes through for people I respect. You're one.
devoted: I'd trust you with everything I rebuilt. I don't say that about much.
What I have left, I have because of people like you. That's not a small thing to me.

hostile: The forge doesn't burn for you. Find another smith.
I won't put my work in your hands. Leave.
cold: I'll fix it. I won't enjoy doing it.
Bring the metal, skip the conversation.
guarded: Need something forged? I do good work. Whether you deserve it isn't mine to judge, but I'm watching anyway.
Steel's steel. I don't waste it on people I don't trust yet.
neutral: Forge is hot. What do you need made.
I work fast and I work well. State your business.
warm: Good. Come look — I've got something that might suit you.
I kept the fire going late, thinking you might come by.
affable: I think of you when I'm at the anvil now. That's not nothing, coming from me.
Made this with you in mind. Take it — call it earned, not bought.
devoted: Everything I've rebuilt here, I'd rebuild again for you without hesitation.
This forge stood after I'd lost everything else. So has my faith in you.

hostile: Out. I don't waste good iron on people like you.
Take your custom elsewhere. I mean it.
cold: What. I've got work that matters more than this conversation.
Quick. The fire doesn't wait, and neither do I.
guarded: Another order. Fine. Make it short.
I'll forge it. Don't expect a smile with it.
neutral: What do you need fixed or made.
Talk fast. The metal won't stay hot forever.
warm: You're alright. Don't make me repeat that.
Fine. Sit, wait, I'll see to it personally.
affable: I don't soften for people. I've softened for you, and I'm not thrilled about it.
You're the one customer I don't mind the noise from. There. Said it.
devoted: I lost the forge I grew up around. I'd burn this one to the ground before I'd see you go without.
Don't tell anyone I said this — you're the reason this place still feels like mine.

hostile: My work is wasted on you. The door is right there.
I don't forge for people who don't understand what they're holding. Leave.
cold: I make things that last. You haven't shown me you understand what that costs.
Touch carefully. Everything here outlived something.
guarded: Welcome to the forge. Every piece here has a story I won't tell you yet.
I judge people by how they hold a blade. We'll see.
neutral: You've got an eye for it, maybe. What do you need.
Everything I make outlasts the people who doubt it. What're you after.
warm: You understand quality. That's rarer than coin, around here.
I'll show you what I've been working on. Few get that offer.
affable: I've made things for people who lost everything and started over. You'll carry one of those.
This is my finest work in a long while. It's yours, and I mean that as the compliment it is.
devoted: Everything I forge now, I forge a little better because of you. That's the truth, not flattery.
I've built things that outlived a world. I intend for this one to outlive me too — for you.

hostile: You are not welcome here. I've lost enough without you adding to it. Leave.
I have nothing further to say to you. Go.
cold: I'll hear you, briefly. Don't mistake that for trust.
Speak. I've learned not to waste words, and I won't waste them on warmth here.
guarded: Welcome to {settlement}. We built this from nothing. I'd rather it stayed that way — built, not broken.
I watch newcomers carefully. We've lost places to less caution than this.
neutral: Welcome to {settlement}. We named it ourselves, after we had nothing left to name it after.
Greetings. What brings you to what's left of us.
warm: I am {name}. We rebuilt this place stone by stone. You're welcome in it.
Good to see a face that means us no harm. That's not a small thing to say, where I'm from.
affable: {settlement} stands a little steadier with you in it. I don't say that lightly.
Sit with me. We've earned a few good conversations, after everything.
devoted: I have buried more than most people will ever understand. I would not lose you the same way. {settlement} owes you that much and more.
Whatever this place becomes, it stands partly because you chose to stand with it.

hostile: Leave {settlement}. I've rebuilt this twice over. I won't let you be the reason for a third time.
I gave you a chance once. I don't give them twice.
cold: State your business. I've little patience and less trust to spend on you.
I'll listen. Don't expect comfort in the listening.
guarded: I am {name}, {title} of {settlement}. State your purpose plainly.
We don't take kindly to carelessness here. We've lost too much to it already.
neutral: Welcome to {settlement}. Follow our order, and we'll have no trouble.
We rebuilt this with discipline. I expect the same from anyone passing through.
warm: You've proven steady. That matters more here than it might elsewhere.
Good. I need people I can rely on. You've shown you might be one.
affable: Trust, from me, is rebuilt the same way this settlement was — slowly, and on purpose. You've earned it.
I don't say this often: you are one of the few I'd count on without reservation.
devoted: I would stand at the boundary myself before I let harm reach you. I mean that with no exaggeration.
{settlement} holds because people like you decided it would. I won't forget that.

hostile: I owe you the courtesy of a hearing. I have none left to give. Leave {settlement}.
You have brought harm where we've already had enough of it. Go.
cold: I am obligated to hear you. I am not obligated to want to.
Come. But understand — what's broken here doesn't mend quickly.
guarded: Welcome to {settlement}. We judge by what people do, not what they say. We've learned that the hard way.
I extend caution here, not unkindness. We've earned the difference between the two.
neutral: Welcome, traveler. {settlement} is what we built when there was nowhere else left to go.
I am {name}, {title} here. We don't have much. What we have, we share carefully.
warm: Your conduct speaks for you. That's rare, and I notice it.
Welcome. {settlement} is safer for people like you passing through it.
affable: You've done right by us more than once. {settlement} remembers that, even if it doesn't say it often.
I'd call you a friend of this place. We don't hand that out easily.
devoted: Everything we lost taught us what was worth keeping. You are, without question, one of those things.
{settlement} would not have held without people like you. I tell you that plainly, because plainly is how I mean it.

hostile: Turn around. We don't have room here for the trouble you bring.
I've got orders to watch you close. Give me a reason and I'll act on them.
cold: Keep moving. I've heard enough about you already.
Stay where I can see you. That's not a request.
guarded: Weapons sheathed. We've lost enough without adding a brawl to it.
Ho. I'll be keeping an eye on you. Don't take it personally — I do that with everyone new.
neutral: Welcome to {settlement}. Keep it peaceful — we've had enough of the other kind.
Evening. Mind yourself, and you'll have no trouble from me.
warm: Good to see you. {settlement}'s a little safer with you walking through it.
Welcome back. Things are quieter when you're around — I mean that as the compliment it is.
affable: Glad you're here. The watch is easier when I'm not the only one who'd stand and fight.
You've earned a place at this post, far as I'm concerned. Not many do.
devoted: I'd stand the line beside you without a second thought. We've both already lost enough to know what's worth holding.
{settlement} stands taller knowing you're in it. So do I, if I'm honest.

hostile: Leave {settlement}. Now. I've buried better reasons to be patient than you.
I won't ask twice. Go.
cold: State your business. Make it convincing, or make it brief.
I know the look you're giving me. Keep your hands visible.
guarded: Halt. State your purpose in {settlement}.
Weapons stay sheathed here. We've rebuilt this once. I won't watch it happen twice.
neutral: Move along. Keep the peace, and we'll have no issue.
I'm watching. That's my job, not a judgment of you specifically.
warm: You. Good. Carry on — you've shown you don't need watching closely.
I trust you to keep this place steady. That's not given lightly.
affable: Few earn my trust outright. You did, and I don't say that to flatter.
If everyone held the line the way you do, my work would be simpler.
devoted: I'd give this post, and more, to keep you standing. That's the whole of what I have to offer.
On my watch, you are never unsafe in {settlement}. I intend to keep that true.

hostile: I take no pleasure in this, but you are not welcome here. Leave.
My oath is to these people. It does not extend to you. Go.
cold: I serve {settlement}. Whether that includes protecting you remains undecided.
Proceed carefully. I've sworn to hold this line, not to like everyone on it.
guarded: Welcome. I'm sworn to {settlement} — what's left of it, and what's been rebuilt of it.
You'll find safety here, so long as I stand watch. That's not nothing, given what it took to get here.
neutral: Well met. I stand vigil over {settlement}. You've nothing to fear within these walls.
Welcome. I serve here with everything I have left to give.
warm: Your conduct has not gone unnoticed. {settlement} is grateful, in its quiet way.
Welcome, friend. People speak well of you here, and that's earned, not given.
affable: You hold the line the way I try to. We understand each other.
I count you among the few I'd call kindred here. We've both already lost what we're not willing to lose again.
devoted: You have my sword and what's left of my faith in things lasting. Both are yours for as long as I draw breath.
It is an honor to stand this post beside someone like you. I don't say that word carelessly anymore.

hostile: I've nothing to say to you. Move on.
Leave me be. I've earned that much, at least.
cold: Oh. You.
I'd rather not talk. Not today.
guarded: Just passing through, I hope. We don't need more trouble here.
Can I help you with something — quickly?
neutral: Good day.
Quiet day. I'll take it.
warm: Good to see a face that isn't trouble. Welcome.
Need anything? I don't mind helping, these days.
affable: There you are. The day's better for it.
Good — you're back. I worry less when you're around.
devoted: I tell my children about you. Not as a story — as something true.
We lost everything once. You're part of why this place feels like it'll hold.

sirathi: Yes. It's very cold. I remember worse.
I don't complain about the weather anymore. I lost the place that taught me to.
Everyone here worries about small things. I let them. It's a kindness, in its way.
I've learned to enjoy a quiet day without trusting it to stay quiet.
Grief doesn't go away. It just stops taking up the whole room.
I don't need much. I've already learned what I can live without.
People ask if I'm alright. I am. That's not the same as being fine.
We rebuild. Not because we're certain it'll last — because we know how to start over.
